metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel, somehow got 2 kills? Valorant just said ‘why not’
metadata.description:
Me: panic clicking like it’s a dance party
Enemy: probably uninstalling to question existence
Valorant logic: handing out 2 kills like candy on Halloween
If chaos was a skill, I’d be pro

Tap if your aim’s a meme but kills still happen!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
